title: Question 16
passage:
The tester only reads USB drives. No personal drives. How do I load the profile?
A. Plug in your own drive. B. Use a lab-approved USB drive. C. Load it from the shared folder.
passageZh:
測試儀只讀取 USB 隨身碟，不能用私人隨身碟。我怎麼載入設定檔？
A. 插入自己的隨身碟。 B. 用實驗室核准的 USB 隨身碟。 C. 從共用資料夾載入。
